summary: ASA Valguero uses Grendel, the new Megaraptor guardian. The roaming Broodmother is a separate encounter; the ASE triple-boss arena does not apply.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.

steps.title: 1 · Prepare for sustained pressure
steps.reason: Stock herbivore cakes, suitable saddles and backup breeding pairs; account for bleed and minions separately.

steps.title: 2 · World boss versus guardian
steps.reason: A roaming Broodmother encounter is not completion of the Valguero guardian arena.

steps.title: 3 · Grendel: Gamma → Beta → Alpha
steps.reason: Practice focused whistles and keep the team together. Watch minions as well as boss health.

loadouts.entry: Check current ASA tribute and creature eligibility at the terminal before committing your team.
loadouts.warning: A creator describes a five-tame solo win, but the team species and stats were not verified here; it is not presented as a victory recipe.

options.title: Herbivores and cakes · Gamma practice plan
options.team: Prepare a saddled herbivore breeding line, cakes in each inventory and eligible rider support.
options.why: Recovery supplies help sustain pressure from bleed and adds. Test the proposal in your save; it is not the creator’s verified team.
options.play: Keep the army together and watch bleed and vultures. Raise difficulty only after Gamma leaves a supply margin.
options.confidence: Conservative planning proposal; no minimum health, melee or saddle values and no independently verified win for this team.
